summary: An excerpt from a fiction manuscript (labeled Book 14, part 133) in which a first-person narrator, frightened, has gotten away from a sleeping or drugged man named Simon in his apartment. She sprays him with Axe, considers weapons, waits behind a locked bathroom door until a record stops, then retrieves a knife and checks on him. Back inside after stepping onto the porch, she copies his videos and photos from his iPhone to her computer, then searches his pockets for a second phone and tries passwords to unlock it.
one_line: A frightened narrator secretly copies a sleeping man's phone data and tries passcodes to unlock his second phone.
key_facts: The narrator remembered to switch off the camera before looking for a weapon.
She considered spraying a can of Axe into the man's eyes as a weapon.
She was too scared to unlock the door to the kitchen where a knife could be found.
The man's blurry voice called out "Baaaaybee . . . " before fading.
She waited until the record finished playing and everything was quiet before opening the door.
When she nudged the man with the toe of her boot, it felt like poking a sandbag.
She stood on the porch holding the knife when the cold air cleared the fog in her head.
She remembered why she had come to his apartment in the first place.
His iPhone was sticking out of his back pocket, and she drew it out with her finger and thumb.
She plugged the iPhone's USB cable into her computer and logged in using his passcode.
She dragged all of his stored videos and photos to her desktop, since she could not figure out how to copy his message files or contacts.
Simon was out so cold he did not move as she searched his pockets for the other phone.
The second phone was in his right pocket, the side he had been lying on.
After she rolled him onto his back, he groaned, then snuffled and started to snore.
When she powered on the second phone, it asked for a password.
She tried the passwords "njme" and "simonisgr8" and then tried other lazy passwords.

entities.name: Simon
entities.role: the man in the apartment, curled up on the bed, who is drowsy or unconscious and whose iPhone and second phone the narrator handles

entities.name: Axe
entities.role: a can of body spray the narrator considers using as a weapon against Simon's eyes
